Bug_Title: Classes should not access their own subclasses during class initialization
Bug_Explanation: Referencing a static member of a subclass from its parent during class initialization can create an initialization cycle or even a deadlock in some extreme cases. Additionally, if the order of the static class members is changed, the behavior of the program might change.
Trigger_Explanation: The test simply calls the `showBug` method of the `Parent` class. This triggers the bug as the `showBug` method contains the line of code that accesses a static member of a subclass from its parent class during class initialization.
